issue_request: FHIR-13859 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core MnM change request from STU3 asking to add the "special" and "meta" diagrams to the data types page because readers could otherwise assume the visible diagrams showed all datatype categories.
initial_application: The Jira comment says "already done". No FHIR-13859-keyed source commit was found, but git commit 7508d2f2cbc6e6e4b77037539465e714c045a3d0, tagged as #13363, added source/datatypes/metadatatypes.diagram and source/datatypes/specialtypes.diagram and inserted both diagrams into source/datatypes.html.
additional_context: FHIR-13363 is a related Published/Persuasive-with-Modification datatype issue whose resolution explicitly included extending the diagrams at the top of the data types pages to include all types. Current source/fhir.ini keeps the datatype family and metadata/special-purpose type pages in the active publishing model. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes this conclusion.
